original_description: Search the Songs To Your Eyes production-music licensing catalogue directly from your chat. Describe a scene or a mood, for example tense investigative underscore that never resolves, and get matching cues for film, TV, advertising and online video. Find music that fits an exact runtime, see the stems and shorter cuts of a track, find similar cues, and get cue-sheet credits (writers, publishers and ISRC). Every result links to a player page where you can listen instantly. Licensing is arranged with the Songs To Your Eyes team, outside the chat.
summary_ja: 映画や動画の場面・長さに合うライセンス楽曲を検索。
limitations: ライセンスの手配はチャット外で提供元チームと行うと説明。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
